rule_metadata.rule_name_english: Madd Tabii (Natural Madd) & Madd Muttasil (Connected Madd)
rule_metadata.description: Comprehensive rules covering the foundational 2-count natural lengthening and the 4-to-5 count obligatory connected lengthening caused by a following Hamzah in the same word.

madd_tabii.name: Madd Tabii (Natural / Original Madd)
madd_tabii.definition: The baseline lengthening that does not depend on a Hamzah or Sukoon. It occurs when a Madd letter (Alif preceded by Fathah, Waw Saakinah preceded by Dammah, or Ya Saakinah preceded by Kasrah) stands alone without a trigger.

madd_muttasil.name: Madd Muttasil (Obligatory Connected Madd)
madd_muttasil.definition: Occurs when a Madd letter is immediately followed by a Hamzah (ء) within the **same single word**.
madd_muttasil.ruling: Obligatory (Wajib) extension of 4 to 5 counts according to the narration of Hafs 'an 'Asim.

practical_examples.breakdown: Alif preceded by Fathah; elongated for precisely 2 counts.
Alif Madd followed by Hamzah inside the same word; extended for 4-5 counts.
Waw Madd followed by Hamzah in the same word.
